title: Increase Horizontal Spacing (AlignAndSize)

scenarios.title: Increase Horizontal Spacing applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Increase Horizontal Spacing (BtnIncreaseHorizontalSpacing) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Increase Horizontal Spacing adds the configured increment between neighbours
scenarios.expected: On a three-shape fixture with horizontal gaps of 50 and 60 the +10 increment moves the left-most shape not at all and the next ones by one and two increments, so the gaps become 60 and 70 (each grew by exactly the increment); the Top values and the source geometry stay untouched and the matching decrement restores the original layout exactly.

scenarios.title: BtnIncreaseHorizontalSpacing deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: Increase horizontal spacing adds the documented increment between neighbours and leaves the unselected shapes' vertical positions alone.

scenarios.expected: Increase horizontal spacing adds the documented increment between neighbours and leaves the unselected shapes' vertical positions alone.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
